label.en: scheduled E3 departures per weekday at the stops suspended by STPT notice 11065

e3.method: GTFS stop_times of trips of route R_AB_E3 whose service runs that day (calendar.txt weekday flags and date range, then calendar_dates.txt add/remove). Departures only: the last stop of a trip is not counted. Stops: the names the notice suspends, per direction, matched to E3's own pattern. Calendar day = local clock (Europe/Bucharest); times >= 24:00 roll to the next day.
